messages:
alex_support: FYI customer acme-inc opened a ticket — after our nightly key rotation their service reports 403 only for generation/chat calls. Embeddings and rerank still succeed. They've got a blocking deployment (payments flow).
maria_cs: ugh. any error body from the API? 403 text?
alex_support: yes. paste from their logs:
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json
{
  \"error\": \"insufficient_scope\",
  \"missing_scopes\": [\"generation\"]
}
```
alex_support: token they provided when introspected shows the scopes claim is weird. see snippet below from their secret-manager /provisioner logs:
```
provisioner: provisioned token for tenant=acme-inc scopes=\"[\"generation\",\"embeddings\"]\"
```
devon_eng: whoa — looks like scopes got embedded as a JSON string instead of a normal space/comma separated list.
maria_cs: so embdeds still work because we match substring? or because embeddings permission check flows differently?
devon_eng: embeddings check currently accepts either explicit \"embeddings\" in the claim string or does a substring match for backward compat. generation check is strict equality on parsed tokens, we don't parse JSON inside claims.
nina_infra: any recent changes to the provisioner or redwoodctl? customer mentioned they started using a new CI pipeline version yesterday.
alex_support: customer says they upgraded their onboarding script to use redwoodctl 0.9.2 when rotating service tokens.
devon_eng: 0.9.2 had a change where --scopes was passed through a library that json-encodes lists for convenience. looks like the provisioner persisted the literal string: `[\"generation\",\"embeddings\"]` into the token claim.
maria_cs: repro steps? can we reproduce quickly in staging?
devon_eng: repro steps I used locally:
1) redwoodctl v0.9.2: `redwoodctl auth create-token --scopes='["generation","embeddings"]' --service acme-staging`
2) inspect token claim: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/introspect`
3) observe `scopes` claim equals the literal string: `[\"generation\",\"embeddings\"]`
4) call generation endpoint: 403 insufficient_scope
5) call embeddings endpoint: 200 OK
nina_infra: can confirm in staging logs we see the same pattern when running the customer's onboarding script.
alex_support: customer asked for immediate workaround. they can't roll back quickly because it's baked into their IaC, they can run one-off script though.
devon_eng: quick workarounds:
- have them downgrade redwoodctl to 0.9.1 and re-rotate tokens (fast)
- or re-provision using our API directly: `POST /v1/service-tokens { \"scopes\": \"generation embeddings\" }` (we accept space-separated string)
- we can also patch the provisioner to strip wrapping quotes and JSON arrays for now (engineering action)
maria_cs: i'll pass both options to the customer. they prefer us to hotfix since they rotate nightly.
devon_eng: I'll open an internal bug and backport a fix to the provisioner parsing. minimal change: if scopes claim starts with `[` and ends with `]`, try to json-decode it and normalize to space-separated string before validation.
nina_infra: can we also add a transient telemetry alert so we catch any tenant tokens with JSON-array scopes? set a query: `logs where scopes LIKE '%[\"%\"%]%'` or similar.
devon_eng: good call. will add alert and a one-time migration job to normalize existing tokens (run once, idempotent).
alex_support: escalation: customer asked for ETA and wants to know if they can be unblocked within the day. maria, can you offer the downgrade steps and request token re-rotation as stopgap?
maria_cs: yes, sent steps and offered to help rotate manually. they accepted manual rotation for now. I've included devon in the ticket for the code fix + migration.
devon_eng: opening ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4721 — priority P1 for prod effect. assigning to eng-runtime. plan: patch parsing (1d), rollout (1d), migration job (couple hours), plus alerting.
alex_support: thanks. adding slack reaction :thumbsup:
slo_bot: Incident created: INF-4721 (P1) — scheduler notified for hourly updates.
maria_cs: customer confirmed manual rotation worked and generation calls resumed. marking customer as unblocked, leaving INF-4721 open for root cause fix.
alex_support: closing loop with customer and leaving instructions to pin redwoodctl <=0.9.1 until fix is live. will update thread once migration runs.
